name: browsjp-pierre
author: ta_terunuma

sections.description:
browsjp-pierre is a tool that simplifies form input.
The libraries used, browsjp_pierre.js and browsget.js, are stored at https://zipaddr.github.io/.
Its main features are as follows.
1. Strong security
2. Easy to install
3. High auto-editing capabilities for fields
For a detailed explanation of browsjp-pierre, please refer to https://browsjp.com/wordpress/.
Please refer to https://browsjp.com/kiyaku.html for the Terms of Use.

The plugin externally references zipaddr.github.io as a repository for its libraries.
Please note that github.io is a site operated by GitHub, Inc. For terms of service and privacy policy, please refer to https://docs.github.com/.
The libraries stored within it are: browsget.js, which handles the main data processing; and browsjp_pierre.js, which acts as a bridge between the main library and WooCommerce.
The library handles personal information required for input/output processing and is updated with each version upgrade.
You are free to use these libraries at your own risk.
sections.installation:
1. Upload browsjp-pierre to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

short_description: browsjp-pierre is a tool that simplifies form input and enhances security by storing data in the browser's localStorage.
